preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines() for x in line.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All integers in input are within the bounds 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5 and 0 ≤ m ≤ min(n(n-1)/2, 10^5).
The input has exactly m+1 lines: the first line contains n and m, followed by m lines of edge pairs.
Each of the m edge lines contains exactly two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(int(a) != int(b) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: No edge has identical endpoints (a_i ≠ b_i).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= n and 1 <= int(b) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are within the vertex range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: len({(int(a), int(b)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()]}) == m
preconditions.description: No edge appears more than once in the input.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().isdigit() and (int(stdout.strip()) == (n - 1) if m == 0 else int(stdout.strip()) >= 0)
postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the weight of the minimum spanning tree (MST). If all edges are 0 (m=0), the MST weight is n-1 (all edges in the tree are 0). Otherwise, the weight is the sum of the smallest (n-1) edges in the graph, where edges are prioritized by weight (0 < 1).

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == (m - (n - 1 - m)) if m >= n - 1 else int(stdout.strip()) == (n - 1)
postconditions.description: The MST weight is equal to the number of edges with weight 1 in the MST. If m ≥ n-1, the MST includes exactly (n-1 - m) edges of weight 0 (since the graph is complete, the remaining edges are 1). Otherwise, the MST includes all edges of weight 0 (n-1 edges).

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == min(m, n - 1) if m <= n - 1 else int(stdout.strip()) == (m - (n - 1 - m))
postconditions.description: The MST weight is the minimum between m and n-1 if m ≤ n-1 (all edges in MST are 1), otherwise it is the number of edges of weight 1 in the MST, which is m - (n-1 - m) = 2m - n + 1.
